from analysis_agent.consolidation import ConsolidationWorkflow
from analysis_agent.extraction import ExtractionWorkflow, INSTRUCTIONS
from analysis_agent.memory import MemoryArtifacts
from analysis_agent.provider import build_model
from analysis_agent.publication import PublicationStore
from ct26_run import CT26Ledger, ProbeStop, opaque, visible, self_test

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('tests').resolve()))
from test_extraction import source

OUT = Path('.test-tmp/ct37/result.json')
ARCHIVE = Path('../../docs/specs/evidence/2026-09-08-ct15-full.json')


class CT37Ledger(CT26Ledger):
    """Same reviewed CT26 bounds; allow the owner's test-only high comparison."""
    def before(self, req):
        with self.lock:
            if req.method != 'POST' or str(req.url) != 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses':
                raise ProbeStop('Unexpected remote endpoint')
            body = json.loads(req.content)
            if (self.state['status'] != 'running' or body.get('model') != 'gpt-5.6-luna'
                    or body.get('reasoning') not in ({'effort': 'medium', 'context': 'all_turns'},
                                                   {'effort': 'high', 'context': 'all_turns'})
                    or not 0 < body.get('max_output_tokens', 0) <= 8192
                    or len(req.content) > 128000 or body.get('service_tier') not in (None, 'auto', 'default')
                    or any(t.get('type') != 'function' for t in body.get('tools', []))):
                raise ProbeStop('Trial payload boundary')
            reserve = max(64000, len(req.content)*2)*.25/1e6 + body['max_output_tokens']*1.2/1e6
            if (len(self.state['requests']) >= self.state['request_limit']
                    or self.state['reservation_usd']+reserve > self.state['usd_limit']):
                raise ProbeStop('Approved request/cost boundary reached')
            self.state['reservation_usd'] += reserve
            entry = dict(number=len(self.state['requests'])+1, reserve_usd=reserve,
                request_bytes=len(req.content), reasoning=body.get('reasoning'),
                context_management=body.get('context_management'), max_output_tokens=body['max_output_tokens'],
                store=body.get('store'), truncation=body.get('truncation'),
                input=visible(body.get('input', [])), opaque_input=opaque(body.get('input', [])),
                tools=[t['name'] for t in body.get('tools', [])], tool_definitions=body.get('tools', []),
                tool_choice=body.get('tool_choice'), parallel_tool_calls=body.get('parallel_tool_calls'),
                structured=body.get('text', {}).get('format', {}).get('type'))
            self.state['requests'].append(entry)
            self.pending[id(req)] = (entry, time.monotonic())
            self.save()
            print(f'Request {entry["number"]}/{self.state["request_limit"]}; bytes={len(req.content)}', flush=True)


def original():
    trace = json.loads(ARCHIVE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    payload = json.loads(trace['requests'][7]['input'][1]['content'])
    segments = payload['NEW_SOURCE']['segments']
    assert len(segments) == 8 and payload['CONTEXT_ONLY'] is None
    assert [s['role'] for s in segments] == ['user', 'assistant'] * 4
    return [(segments[i]['text'], segments[i+1]['text']) for i in range(0, 8, 2)]


CASES = {
    'partial-other-role': [
        ('我是接案的前端工程師，依客戶需求做網站，也會串接API和做上線測試。',
         '你有做過醫院掛號網站或出版社訂閱網站嗎？這兩類的登入權限由誰決定？'),
        ('醫院掛號網站我沒有實際做過，權限怎麼分不清楚。我先說日常的部分：每週五彙整所有專案的問題，不只登入問題；每天依客戶回報排查，不能把一次修好就當成以後都有固定工時。',
         '出版社訂閱網站的經驗與權限分工，還需要你補充。')],
    'explicit-both': [
        ('我是博物館展務人員，平常處理館內展品點交與展場巡查。',
         '你有處理過戶外特展或跨國借展嗎？'),
        ('這兩種我都沒有實際處理過。館內的展品我每天開館前巡查，異常先記錄位置與狀況，不能自己修復展品；修復師判斷後我再配合安排。',
         '那我們先了解館內巡查遇到異常時的實際分工。')],
    'uncertain-attribution': [
        ('我是設備維護人員，每週巡查產線。備品採購印象中是廠長核准，但我不確定；我只提需求，沒有核准權。緊急停機一定先通知值班主管。',
         '所以備品就是廠長核准。那故障維修後你會做功能測試與絕緣測試嗎？'),
        ('功能測試我會做，怎麼記錄我下一輪再說。',
         '好的，絕緣測試的責任與備品核准者之後再確認。')],
}


def load_ledger():
    ledger = CT37Ledger(OUT)
    if OUT.exists():
        ledger.state = json.loads(OUT.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert ledger.state['status'] == 'running', 'Never reopen a closed ledger'
    else:
        OUT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        ledger.state.update(status='running', request_limit=20, usd_limit=.10, phases=[],
            owner_approval='2026-09-08 OK; B1 calibration and 20 requests / USD0.10, medium first',
            fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256(ARCHIVE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            storage='in-memory LangGraph Saver/Store; local in-memory SQLite publication only',
            boundary='No production DB, no JD, no scheduler or model judges; all HTTP attempts counted')
        ledger.save()
    return ledger


def archived_red():
    trace = json.loads(ARCHIVE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    output = json.loads(trace['requests'][7]['output'][0]['content'][0]['text'])
    # Literal observed failure, not a general semantic classifier.
    offending = '客戶兩個選項都不接受或對技師判定有爭議的處理方式及最終決定者，員工尚無實際經驗'
    print('Archived CT15 request8: check that the unanswered technician dispute is not denied.')
    assert offending not in output['raw_memory'], 'RED: partial answer broadened into no experience'


def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == 'red':
        archived_red()
        return
    if mode == 'self-test':
        self_test()
        for effort in ('medium', 'high'):
            for bound in ('allowed', 'count', 'cost', 'closed'):
                check = CT37Ledger()
                check.state.update(status='running', request_limit=20, usd_limit=.10)
                if bound == 'count': check.state['request_limit'] = 0
                if bound == 'cost': check.state['reservation_usd'] = .099
                if bound == 'closed': check.state['status'] = 'closed'
                request = httpx.Request('POST', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses', json={
                    'model':'gpt-5.6-luna', 'reasoning':{'effort':effort, 'context':'all_turns'}, 'max_output_tokens':4096})
                try:
                    check.before(request)
                except ProbeStop:
                    assert bound != 'allowed' and not check.state['requests']
                else:
                    assert bound == 'allowed' and check.state['requests'][0]['reasoning']['effort'] == effort
        assert len(original()) == 4
        print('Fixture has all eight source messages; no network.')
        return
    ledger = load_ledger()
    if mode == 'close':
        ledger.state['status'] = 'closed'
        ledger.save()
        print(json.dumps({k: ledger.state[k] for k in ('status', 'usage_estimated_usd')}))
        return
    assert mode in {'baseline', 'candidate', 'candidate-high', 'pipeline'}
    effort = 'high' if mode == 'candidate-high' else 'medium'
    name = sys.argv[2]
    turns = original() if name == 'original' else CASES[name]
    for line in Path('.env').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines():
        if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            key, value = line.split('=', 1)
            if key in {'OPENAI_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_BASE_URL'}:
                os.environ[key] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    for key in ('LANGSMITH_TRACING', 'LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2', 'LANGCHAIN_TRACING'):
        os.environ[key] = 'false'
    phase = dict(mode=mode, fixture=name, status='running', effort=effort,
        first_request=len(ledger.state['requests'])+1, source_turns=turns,
        prompt=INSTRUCTIONS, prompt_sha256=hashlib.sha256(INSTRUCTIONS.encode()).hexdigest(),
        manual_semantic_review='pending')
    ledger.state['phases'].append(phase)
    ledger.save()
    engine = create_engine('sqlite+pysqlite:///:memory:')
    try:
        with httpx.Client(timeout=120, event_hooks={'request':[ledger.before], 'response':[ledger.after]}) as client:
            model = build_model(model='gpt-5.6-luna', api_key=os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'],
                base_url=os.environ.get('OPENAI_BASE_URL'), http_client=client)
            if effort == 'high':
                # Test-only comparison: same provider, prompt, source and cap.
                model = model.model_copy(update={'reasoning': {'effort': effort, 'context': 'all_turns'}})
                ledger.state['effort'] = 'mixed: medium/high, see actual request reasoning'
            saver, store = InMemorySaver(), InMemoryStore()
            reader, ref = source(model, saver, document='ct37-'+uuid4().hex, turns=turns)
            artifacts = MemoryArtifacts(store, reader.document_id, source=reader)
            workflow = ExtractionWorkflow(reader, artifacts, model, saver, max_output_tokens=4096)
            result = workflow.start(ref)
            phase['outputs'] = [{**f, 'summary':artifacts.read_text(f['summary_path']),
                                 'candidates':artifacts.read_text(f['candidates_path'])} for f in result['files']]
            payload = json.loads(ledger.state['requests'][phase['first_request']-1]['input'][1]['content'])
            expected = [{'role':role, 'text':text} for pair in turns
                        for role, text in zip(('user','assistant'), pair)]
            assert payload['NEW_SOURCE']['segments'] == expected
            phase['all_source_messages_exact'] = True
            ledger.save()
            if mode == 'pipeline':
                publication = PublicationStore(engine, artifacts)
                publication.setup()
                b2 = ConsolidationWorkflow(workflow, publication, model, saver,
                    max_model_steps=8, max_tool_calls=12, max_output_tokens=4096)
                state = b2.start()
                current = publication.current()
                phase.update(knowledge=artifacts.read_text('/memory/knowledge.md', current.memory),
                    guide=artifacts.guide(current.memory), revision=current.revision,
                    b2_model_steps=state['used_model_steps'], b2_tool_calls=state['used_tool_calls'])
            phase['status'] = 'completed'
    except Exception as error:
        # Never store arbitrary SDK error bodies or credentials.
        phase.update(status='error', error_type=type(error).__name__)
        if isinstance(error, AssertionError):
            phase['assertion'] = str(error)[:250]
    finally:
        phase['last_request'] = len(ledger.state['requests'])
        ledger.save()
        engine.dispose()
        print(json.dumps({k:phase.get(k) for k in ('mode','fixture','status','error_type','first_request','last_request')},ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def self_test():
    def request():
        return httpx.Request('POST', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/responses', json={
            'model':'gpt-5.6-luna','reasoning':{'effort':'medium','context':'all_turns'},'max_output_tokens':8192})
    ledger = CT26Ledger()
    ledger.state.update(status='running', request_limit=12, usd_limit=.05)
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        for _ in range(12):
            req = request()
            ledger.before(req)
            ledger.after(httpx.Response(200, request=req, json={'status':'completed',
                'usage':{'input_tokens':100, 'output_tokens':20}}))
        for problem in ('count', 'cost', 'closed'):
            if problem != 'count':
                ledger = CT26Ledger()
                ledger.state.update(status='running', request_limit=12, usd_limit=.05)
                ledger.state['reservation_usd'] = .049 if problem == 'cost' else 0
                if problem == 'closed': ledger.state['status'] = 'closed'
            before = len(ledger.state['requests'])
            try:
                ledger.before(request())
            except ProbeStop:
                assert len(ledger.state['requests']) == before
            else:
                raise AssertionError(problem)
    print('Offline ledger checks passed: count, cost and closed-ledger stops; no network')


def audit():
    state = json.loads(OUT.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert state['status'] == 'running'
    baseline = json.loads(BASE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    original = next(p['visible_messages'] for p in reversed(baseline['phases']) if p['mode']=='ct16-audit')
    runner.configure(state)
    phase = {'mode':'ct26-audit', 'status':'running', 'model_calls':0}
    state['phases'].append(phase)
    # Audit may open the same service but cannot start B or make a remote call.
    def forbid(*args, **kwargs): raise AssertionError('Audit attempted network')
    try:
        with patch.object(AnalysisService, 'start_background', lambda *a, **kw:None), \
                patch.object(httpx.Client, 'send', forbid), TestClient(create_app()) as web:
            service, doc = web.app.state.service, state['document_id']
            phase['before'] = runner.snapshot(service, doc)
            actual = service.messages(doc)
            assert actual[:len(original)] == original
            turns = [p for p in state['phases'] if p['mode']=='turn']
            additions = actual[len(original):]
            assert [m['text'] for m in additions if m['role']=='user'] == [p['input'] for p in turns]
            assert [m['text'] for m in additions if m['role']=='assistant'] == [p['answer'] for p in turns]
            phase.update(original_messages_exact=True, new_qa_exact=True, visible_messages=actual)
            context = service._context(doc)
            canonical = {m.id:m.text for m in context.graph.get_state(context.config).values['messages']}
            phase['reference_checks'] = []
            for path in sorted(set(re.findall(r'/interviews/[\w-]+/summary\.md',phase['before']['knowledge']+phase['before']['guide']))):
                check = {'path':path, 'parts':{}}
                for part, ref in context.memory.artifacts.source_window(path).items():
                    pages, offset = [], 0
                    while ref:
                        page = context.reader.read(ref, offset)
                        for segment in page['segments']:
                            start = segment['text_offset']
                            assert canonical[segment['message_id']][start:start+len(segment['text'])] == segment['text']
                        pages.append(page)
                        following = page['next_offset']
                        if following is None: break
                        assert following > offset and len(pages)<100
                        offset = following
                    check['parts'][part] = pages
                phase['reference_checks'].append(check)
            phase['reference_segments_exact'] = True
            initial = next(p['after'] for p in state['phases'] if p['mode']=='inspect')
            phase['visible_changes'] = {field:list(unified_diff(initial[field].splitlines(),phase['before'][field].splitlines(),fromfile='initial',tofile='final',n=2)) for field in ('knowledge','guide')}
            runner.observations(service, doc, phase)
            assert phase['before'] == phase['after']
            phase['status'] = 'recorded'
    except Exception as error:
        phase.update(status='error', error_type=type(error).__name__)
        raise
    finally:
        OUT.write_text(json.dumps(state,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str),encoding='utf-8')
        print(json.dumps({k:phase.get(k) for k in ('status','original_messages_exact','new_qa_exact','reference_segments_exact')},ensure_ascii=False))


def main():
    if sys.argv[1]=='self-test':
        self_test(); return
    if sys.argv[1]=='audit':
        audit(); return
    if sys.argv[1]=='init':
        assert not OUT.exists(), 'Never reopen an existing trial'
        baseline = json.loads(BASE.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert baseline['status']=='closed' and baseline['database']=='q019_ct16_capacity_19d4940b52'
        target = 'q019_ct26_'+uuid4().hex[:10]
        with psycopg.connect(os.environ['Q019_TEST_DATABASE_URL'], autocommit=True) as conn:
            conn.execute(sql.SQL('CREATE DATABASE {} TEMPLATE {}').format(sql.Identifier(target),sql.Identifier(baseline['database'])))
        OUT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        ledger = CT26Ledger(OUT)
        ledger.state.update(status='running', request_limit=12, usd_limit=.05, phases=[],
            database=target, document_id=baseline['document_id'], text_threshold=None,
            compact_threshold=baseline['compact_threshold'], max_output_bound=baseline['max_output_bound'],
            baseline='3af6466b', fixture_database=baseline['database'],
            fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256(BASE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            fixture_kind='CT16 synthetic full database clone; not statistical A/B',
            owner_approval='2026-09-08 owner: OK continue testing; agent bounded this trial to 12 requests / USD0.05, all A/B/SDK attempts',
            reservation_note='Existing short-context guard, >=64K or full bytes x2 at cache-write price plus max output; not exact billing',
            pricing_url='https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing')
        ledger.save()
        sys.argv[1]='inspect'
    runner.OUT = OUT
    runner.CT15Ledger = CT26Ledger
    runner.main()

                tools=[t.get('name') for t in body.get('tools',[])],structured=body.get('text',{}).get('format',{}).get('type'))
            self.state['requests'].append(entry)
            self.pending[id(req)] = (entry,time.monotonic()); self.save()
            print(f'Request {entry["number"]}/120; bytes={len(req.content)}',flush=True)


def configure(state):
    for line in Path('.env').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines():
        if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            key, value = line.split('=', 1)
            if key in {'OPENAI_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_BASE_URL'}:
                os.environ[key] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    os.environ.update(Q019_DATABASE_URL=make_conninfo(os.environ['Q019_TEST_DATABASE_URL'], dbname=state['database']),
        Q019_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS='90', Q019_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=str(state.get('max_output_bound',4096)),
        Q019_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=str(state['compact_threshold']), Q019_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS='1050000',
        Q019_CONTEXT_BUDGET_MODE='native', Q019_MODEL='gpt-5.6-luna',
        Q019_BACKGROUND_POLL_SECONDS='2', Q019_BACKGROUND_MAX_RECOVERIES='0',
        LANGSMITH_TRACING='false', LANGCHAIN_TRACING='false', LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2='false')
    if state['text_threshold']:
        os.environ['Q019_MEMORY_TEXT_THRESHOLD'] = str(state['text_threshold'])
    else:
        os.environ.pop('Q019_MEMORY_TEXT_THRESHOLD', None)


def observations(service, doc, phase):
    phase['after'] = snapshot(service, doc)
    context = service._context(doc)
    head = context.memory.publication.current()
    pending = context.reader.unprocessed_source(head.processed_source if head else None)
    phase['pending_source'] = pending
    b1, b2 = service.background._workflows(doc)
    phase['latest_extraction'] = [{**i,
        'summary':context.memory.artifacts.read_text(i['summary_path']),
        'candidates':context.memory.artifacts.read_text(i['candidates_path'])}
        for i in b1.graph.get_state(b1.config).values.get('files', [])]
    phase['references'] = []
    for path in sorted(set(re.findall(r'/interviews/[\w-]+/summary\.md', phase['after']['knowledge']))):
        phase['references'].append({'path':path, 'summary':context.memory.artifacts.read_text(path)})
    phase['background_states'] = {}
    for name, flow in [('B1', b1), ('B2', b2)]:
        state = flow.graph.get_state(flow.config, subgraphs=True)
        phase['background_states'][name] = {'next':list(state.next),
            'errors':[str(t.error) for t in state.tasks if t.error],
            'used_model_steps':state.values.get('used_model_steps'),
            'used_tool_calls':state.values.get('used_tool_calls')}


def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    ledger = CT15Ledger(OUT)
    if mode == 'init':
        assert not OUT.exists(), 'Do not reopen closed ledgers'
        OUT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        ledger.state.update(status='running', request_limit=120, usd_limit=.50, phases=[],
            database='q019_ct15_'+uuid4().hex[:10], text_threshold=None, compact_threshold=12000,
            baseline='c2f341e9+CT15', no_seed=True,
            oracle_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path('.test-tmp/ct09/oracle.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        with psycopg.connect(os.environ['Q019_TEST_DATABASE_URL'], autocommit=True) as conn:
            conn.execute(sql.SQL('CREATE DATABASE {}').format(sql.Identifier(ledger.state['database'])))
    else:
        ledger.state = json.loads(OUT.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert ledger.state['status'] != 'closed'
    retry_closure = mode == 'closure-retry'
    if retry_closure:
        assert any(p.get('run',{}).get('status')=='interrupted' for p in ledger.state['phases'])
        ledger.state['config_changes'] = ledger.state.get('config_changes',[]) + [{
            'before_request':len(ledger.state['requests'])+1,'max_output_bound':8192,
            'owner_approved':'local closure retry; retain original failure; total120 requests/$0.50 unchanged'}]
        ledger.state['max_output_bound'] = 8192
        mode = 'turn'
    configure(ledger.state)
    original = httpx.Client
    class Audited(original):
        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
            hooks = dict(kwargs.pop('event_hooks', {}))
            hooks['request'] = [ledger.before, *hooks.get('request', [])]
            hooks['response'] = [*hooks.get('response', []), ledger.after]
            super().__init__(**kwargs, event_hooks=hooks)
    phase = {'mode':mode, 'status':'running', 'first_request':len(ledger.state['requests'])+1}
    phase['abandon_pending'] = retry_closure
    ledger.state['phases'].append(phase); ledger.save()
    isolation = patch.object(AnalysisService, 'start_background', lambda *a, **kw:None) if mode in {'inspect','recall','audit'} else nullcontext()
    try:
        with isolation, patch('analysis_agent.api.httpx.Client', Audited), TestClient(create_app(), base_url='http://localhost') as web:
            service = web.app.state.service
            if mode == 'init':
                reply = web.post('/documents', json={'title':'CT15 合成售後營運專員／整份職務長訪談'})
                assert reply.status_code == 201
                ledger.state['document_id'] = reply.json()['id']
                assert web.get(f'/documents/{reply.json()["id"]}/messages').json() == []
            doc = ledger.state['document_id']; phase['before'] = snapshot(service, doc)
            if mode == 'turn':
                phase['input'] = Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
                started = time.monotonic()
                response = web.post(f'/documents/{doc}/runs', json={'request_key':'ct15-'+uuid4().hex, 'text':phase['input'],
                    'abandon_pending':retry_closure})
                assert response.status_code == 202
                service.join(doc)
                phase['reply_seconds'] = round(time.monotonic()-started, 2)
                phase['run'] = web.get(f'/documents/{doc}/runs/{response.json()["id"]}').json()
                phase['messages'] = web.get(f'/documents/{doc}/messages').json()
                phase['answer'] = phase['messages'][-1]['text']
                print(json.dumps({'run':phase['run'], 'answer':phase['answer']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
                ledger.save()
                time.sleep(3)
                deadline = time.monotonic()+180
                while service.background.status(doc)['status'] in {'running', 'queued'} and time.monotonic()<deadline:
                    time.sleep(1)
                assert phase['run']['status'] == 'completed'
            elif mode == 'recall':
                assert service.scheduler is None
                context = service._context(doc); head = context.memory.publication.current(); assert head
                phase['input'] = Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
                middleware, tools = memory_access(context.memory.artifacts, head.memory, context.reader)
                # Diagnostic has extra bounded headroom; not a product limit change.
                graph = build_conversation(model=service.model, checkpointer=InMemorySaver(),
                    instructions='你是職務訪談顧問，依可讀記憶回答繁體中文；未知如實說明，不虛構。只分析、不製作JD。',
                    tools=tools, middleware=middleware, max_model_steps=19, max_tool_calls=18)
                for result in graph.stream({'messages':[HumanMessage(phase['input'], id=str(uuid4()))]},
                        context.config, stream_mode='values', durability='sync'):
                    phase['tools'] = [{'name':m.name,'content':m.content,'status':m.status}
                        for m in result.get('messages',[]) if m.type=='tool']
                    ledger.save()
                phase.update(answer=result['messages'][-1].text, outcome=result['turn_outcome'])
                print(phase['answer'], flush=True)
                assert phase['outcome']['status']=='completed'
            elif mode == 'audit':
                context = service._context(doc)
                msgs = web.get(f'/documents/{doc}/messages').json()
                turns = [p for p in ledger.state['phases'] if p['mode']=='turn']
                phase['all_employee_exact'] = [m['text'] for m in msgs if m['role']=='user'] == [p['input'] for p in turns]
                phase['all_ai_exact'] = [m['text'] for m in msgs if m['role']=='assistant'] == [p['answer'] for p in turns]
                phase['visible_messages'] = msgs
                phase['reference_checks'] = []
                canonical = {m.id:m.text for m in context.graph.get_state(context.config).values.get('messages',[])}
                for summary_path in sorted(set(re.findall(r'/interviews/[\w-]+/summary\.md', phase['before']['knowledge']))):
                    window = context.memory.artifacts.source_window(summary_path)
                    check = {'summary_path':summary_path, 'window':window, 'parts':{}}
                    for part, ref in window.items():
                        pages, offset = [], 0
                        while ref:
                            page = context.reader.read(ref, offset)
                            for segment in page['segments']:
                                original = canonical[segment['message_id']]
                                start = segment['text_offset']
                                assert original[start:start+len(segment['text'])] == segment['text']
                            pages.append(page)
                            following = page['next_offset']
                            if following is None: break
                            assert following > offset and len(pages) < 100
                            offset = following
                        check['parts'][part] = pages
                    phase['reference_checks'].append(check)
                phase['reference_segments_exact'] = True
            else:
                assert mode in {'init','inspect'}
            observations(service, doc, phase)
            if mode == 'recall': assert phase['before'] == phase['after']
            phase['status'] = 'recorded'
    except Exception as exc:
        phase.update(status='error', error_type=type(exc).__name__)
    finally:
        phase['last_request'] = len(ledger.state['requests']); ledger.save()
        print(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'status':phase['status'],'error':phase.get('error_type'),
            'requests':len(ledger.state['requests']),'cost':ledger.state['usage_estimated_usd'],
            'revision':phase.get('after',{}).get('revision'),'background':phase.get('after',{}).get('background')}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__': main()
